description: This file contains the implementation of the CronExpression class, which parses, validates, and computes next or previous run dates for CRON expressions. It includes methods for handling various CRON schedule parts, factory creation with predefined schedules, and determining if a CRON expression is due to run at a given time.

classes.name: CronExpression
classes.description: A class to parse CRON expressions, validate schedule parts, and calculate upcoming or past run dates based on the expression.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory method that creates a CronExpression instance, supporting special shortcuts like '@daily' or '@monthly'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a CRON expression and a field factory.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Sets or updates the CRON expression, parsing it into parts and validating them.

methods.name: setPart
methods.description: Sets a specific part of the CRON expression after validating it with the field factory.

methods.name: getNextRunDate
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled run date after a given date/time.

methods.name: getPreviousRunDate
methods.description: Retrieves the previous scheduled run date before a given date/time.

methods.name: getMultipleRunDates
methods.description: Computes multiple run dates starting from a specific date/time.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Returns the full CRON expression or a specific part.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the CRON expression.

methods.name: isDue
methods.description: Checks if the CRON expression is due to run at the specified current time.

methods.name: getRunDate
methods.description: Core method that finds the next or previous run date satisfying the CRON expression.
